question: How much lighter is the multilayer urea crystal with both layers at 400 °C than the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C?
rendered:
The mass of the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C is 1.118 g. 

The mass of the multilayer urea crystal with both layers at 400 °C is not directly stated, but the mass of the multilayer urea crystal with a first layer at 400 °C and a second layer at 400 °C is 1.055 g.

The difference in mass is 1.118 g - 1.055 g = 0.063 g.

The multilayer urea crystal with both layers at 400 °C is 0.063 g lighter than the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C.
